title: “temporary” code, by age
caption:
nothing is more permanent than a temporary fix.

"// temporary fix", added 2021. older than my contract.
"// TODO: remove before launch". we launched. twice.
test@test.com is our most active user. and const HACK = true? I wrote that one.

what's the oldest "temporary" thing in your codebase?

slide.kicker: the most stable thing here is a hack
